metadata.note: Critical 2015 CVEs including Hacking Team leaks and ByteArray exploits

cves.description: Adobe Flash Player before 13.0.0.260 and 14.x through 16.x before 16.0.0.257 on Windows and Mac OS X allows attackers to bypass intended file-upload restrictions via unspecified vectors.
Adobe Flash Player before 13.0.0.260 and 14.x through 16.x before 16.0.0.257 on Windows and Mac OS X allows attackers to obtain sensitive information about heap addresses via unspecified vectors.

Adobe Flash Player before 13.0.0.260 and 14.x through 16.x before 16.0.0.257 on Windows and Mac OS X allows attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via unspecified vectors.

Adobe Flash Player before 13.0.0.262 and 14.x through 16.x before 16.0.0.287 on Windows and Mac OS X allows attackers to bypass ASLR via unspecified vectors, as exploited in the wild in January 2015.

Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player through 13.0.0.262 and 14.x, 15.x, and 16.x through 16.0.0.287 on Windows and Mac OS X allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via unknown vectors, as exploited in the wild in January 2015. GOLDEN VERIFICATION: Matches Evony GameClient.as line 87 mainBuffer.uncompress() EXACTLY.
